question: In a certain code language, ALBINISM is written as 79. How will NEURON be written in that code?
solution:
**Explanation :**

Table of english alphabet positional value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1adbbf1a08ab8fe30ff354bb829a01906748dbf4a1b177c6387f258a30303dfd.png] 

According to above table

ALBINISM is written as 79

A(1) + L(12) + B(2) + I(9) + N(14) + I(9) + S(19) + M(13) = 79

Similarly,

**NEURON will be written as 87**

N(14) + E(5) + U(21) + R(18) + O(15) + N(14) = 87

Hence, **87 **is the correct answer.
